reference_mesh.HEX8: positive reference Jacobian at all 2x2x2 Gauss points; minimum scaled Jacobian >= 0.20

qualification_envelope.claim_boundary: Finite kinematics is demonstrated only within these strain, determinant, element-quality and loading bounds; StVK is not claimed as a universally valid large-strain material.

implemented_mechanics.deformation_gradient: F = I + sum_a u_a outer grad_X(N_a)
implemented_mechanics.second_piola: S = lambda * tr(E) * I + 2 * mu * E
implemented_mechanics.consistent_tangent: K[a,i;b,k] = integral_V0 dN_a/dX_J * (F[i,I] C[I,J,K,L] F[k,K] + delta[i,k] S[L,J]) * dN_b/dX_L dV0
implemented_mechanics.assembly: TET4 uses constant reference gradients and volume integration; HEX8 uses 2x2x2 Gauss integration; both assemble sparse internal force/tangent and symmetrize the stored tangent.

accepted_state_energy_work.authoritative_source: NonlinearStateTransaction accepted state and the UnifiedNewtonEngine/UnifiedContinuationController accepted-state callback boundary
accepted_state_energy_work.public_result_limitation: A final public SolveResult does not itself expose detached displacement snapshots for every accepted increment.
accepted_state_energy_work.WP04_B_requirement: Qualification harness must collect detached accepted snapshots only from the acceptance callback, never from trial/mirror state.
accepted_state_energy_work.work_definition: W_ext = sum_n 0.5 * (lambda_n F_ext + lambda_(n+1) F_ext)^T * (u_(n+1)-u_n); compare Delta U to refined W_ext for conservative dead loads.

all_or_nothing_policy: Both TET4 and HEX8 must close their target gates. A single-family result cannot earn partial WP04 points or a public maturity promotion.
